capabilities: Archive a direct subtask together with its own workspace, preserving conversation history.
description: Archive one of your direct subtasks. Only its coordinating bot, task, or subtask may do this. Stops the target's current work and running descendants, but marks only the target archived. A workspace-bound subtask's workspace is archived with it; a shared-filesystem subtask leaves the shared folder untouched. Conversation history remains, but archival is final: nobody can restore the subtask. Repeating archival is harmless.
name: archive_subtask
